item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i tshogs bskang chen mo
item.coloph: dbal phur nag po'i tshogs bskang (skong) chen mo zhes bya ba/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi zhal slob pa/ dbal bon kha yal me 'bar gyis/ drag po dbal yul thang brgyad kyi gnas su mdzad pa'o/ de nas dbal bon bco brgyad rim bzhin brgyud nas/ dus kyi bstan pa 'phel 'grib skabs/ bla chen dran pa'i thugs la sbas/ phyis su bstan pa'i dbu brnyes tshe/ sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can la snyan du brgyud pa'o//

item.tib: dbal phur nag po'i tshogs skong chen mo
item.coloph: ces dbal phur nag po'i tshogs skong 'di nyid/ dbal bon stag la me 'bar gyi zhal slob/ dbal bon kha yar me 'bar gyis drag po dbal yul thang brgyad du/ stag la me 'bar gyi bdud rtsi'i thigs pa 'thung pa la brten/ mdos gsum skong ba gsum mdzad pa'i mdos gsum ni/ skong ba ri rab gling bzhi'i mdos/ zlog pa khra spyang zor gyi mdos/ bsad pa ma mo gsum gyi mdos dang gsum mo/ khro tshogs gtsor bstan tshogs skong chen mo dang*/ ma tshogs gtsor bor bstan pa phur pa'i gnad skong dang*/ drag pa gtsor bstan pa srog len dmar po'i skong ba la/ 'di ni tshogs bskang chen mo dang / 'di rnams dbal bon kha yal me 'bar gyis/ dbal bon bco brgyad la rim par brgyud nas/ dbal bon gsas mkhar me 'bar dang / bla chen dran pa nam mkha' gnyis kyis/ spa gro stag tshang seng ge'i phug tu sbas/ khu tsha zla 'od kyis gter bton nas/ rong po 'gar la babs/ de nas rim par brgyud pa legs so//
